name: side to side hop v. 2
description: You hop from one side to the other over an imaginary line. It builds lateral agility, leg power and conditioning.
instructions: Stand on two feet with your knees slightly bent.
Hop sideways to one side, landing softly on the balls of your feet.
Immediately hop back to the other side.
Keep your chest up and your hips low.
Use your arms for balance and rhythm.
Go for a set time or a set number of reps.
